items.text:
10% may be a bit too generous haha, I’d be very happy with that

I think 99.9% of any gurus followers don’t make money for various reasons, expecting it to be as simple as 3 actionable steps and a week of effort is one of them

Took me a year of having no idea what I was doing to even land my first client, most of why it took so long was self sabotage.

Good hook though and I appreciate the positive message

reply_to.text: Why 90% of DAN KOE (@thedankoe) followers never make money.

items.translation_zh:
10% 可能有点太慷慨了哈哈，能到这个比例我就很开心了

我认为任何“大师”的粉丝里有 99.9% 都赚不到钱，原因有很多，指望它像 3 个可执行步骤加一周努力那样简单就是其中之一

我花了一年时间、完全不知道自己在干什么，才拿到第一个客户，之所以花了这么久，大部分原因是自我破坏。

不过这个钩子写得不错，也感谢这份积极的信息

items.text:
I asked Claude to populate a Civilization-style game map with real data from the US. Opus 5.5 downloaded and parse a ton of public data and 7 hours and 45K lines of code later... it works :)

- 31 real data sources including Census, BEA, BLS, EIA, NOAA, USGS, DoD, NPS, FAA, FEMA, CDC...
- Real elevation, land cover, GDP, jobs, power plants, mines, ports, airports, bases, parks, universities, freight flows, disasters; all reconciled onto one 25 km hex grid.
- The data is converted into Civilization language, e.g. Gold yield is GDP. A city's districts are its real industry specializations: San Jose gets a Campus, Detroit is "Motor city". Its citizens are its real workforce: 1 in 4 San Jose workers are engineers, coders or scientists, against 1 in 14 nationally. Wonders are chosen by published rules, such as national parks by visitor numbers and universities by R&D spending, etc etc.
- 19 lenses (income, degrees, faith, disasters…), a City View for 524 metros, and nine advisors plus an Explorer. The Explorer turns any column for any of 3,100+ counties into a table and scatter plot, linked to the map.
- Claude decided to skip a few states and territories sry
- Built using Claude Code desktop app, Opus 5.5 on medium and turning on ultracode.

It's deployed here: https://karpathy.ai/usaciv/ and the "?" has the source link too. I don't exactly know where I was going with this but it's really fun to browse and play with. Possibly it can be expanded or built into a game. I only have half of my weekly Claude quote left though so someone else will have to take over :D. Claude also made a trailer:
items.translation_zh:
我让 Claude 用美国的真实数据来填充一张《文明》（Civilization）风格的游戏地图。Opus 5.5 下载并解析了大量公开数据，7 个小时、4.5 万行代码之后……它跑起来了 :)

- 31 个真实数据源，包括 Census、BEA、BLS、EIA、NOAA、USGS、DoD、NPS、FAA、FEMA、CDC……
- 真实的海拔、土地覆盖、GDP、就业、发电厂、矿山、港口、机场、军事基地、公园、大学、货运流量、灾害；全部统一对齐到一张 25 公里的六边形网格上。
- 数据被转换成《文明》的语言，例如金币产出就是 GDP。一座城市的区域就是它真实的产业专长：San Jose 得到一个学院区（Campus），Detroit 是“汽车城”。它的市民就是它真实的劳动力：San Jose 每 4 个劳动者中就有 1 个是工程师、程序员或科学家，而全国是 14 个中有 1 个。奇观按公开规则选出，比如国家公园按游客数量、大学按研发支出，等等等等。
- 19 种视图（收入、学历、信仰、灾害……），覆盖 524 个都市区的城市视图（City View），还有九位顾问加一个探索者（Explorer）。Explorer 能把 3,100 多个县中任意一列数据变成表格和散点图，并与地图联动。
- Claude 决定跳过了几个州和领地，抱歉
- 用 Claude Code 桌面应用构建，Opus 5.5 设为 medium，并开启了 ultracode。

已经部署在这里：https://karpathy.ai/usaciv/ ，“?” 里也有源码链接。我也不太清楚自己要拿它做什么，但浏览和把玩起来真的很有意思。也许它可以扩展，或者做成一个游戏。不过我这周的 Claude 额度只剩一半了，所以得有别人来接手了 :D。Claude 还做了一个预告片：

analysis.summary: Karpathy 分享了一个业余项目：让 Claude（Opus 5.5，经 Claude Code 桌面应用）用 31 个美国公开数据源，花约 7 小时、写出约 4.5 万行代码，做成一张《文明》风格的美国交互地图，并已上线 karpathy.ai/usaciv。
points: 数据：31 个公开数据源（Census、BEA、BLS、NOAA、USGS 等），统一映射到 25 公里六边形网格
玩法化：GDP 对应金币产出，城市区域对应真实产业专长，奇观按游客数、研发支出等公开规则选出
功能：19 种视图、524 个都市区的 City View、九位顾问和可对 3,100+ 县做表格/散点图的 Explorer
工具：Claude Code 桌面应用，Opus 5.5 medium + ultracode；Claude 跳过了少数州和领地
他说本周 Claude 额度只剩一半，希望别人接手扩展；帖子附有 Claude 做的预告视频（未查看视频内容）
analysis.why: 这是一个“长时间自主 Agent 编程”的具体案例：单次任务跑约 7 小时、产出数万行代码并完成数据获取、清洗和可视化。7 小时、4.5 万行等数字是作者自述；项目被他定位为好玩的业余作品，方向未定。
